description: Get a one-time web link the USER opens in their browser to send their trace file (GPX, TCX, IGC, SBP or FIT, max 8 MiB) to SportsTrackLive, plus the `upload_id` that analyze_activity_file, create_ephemeral_replay and import_activity then accept. Use it whenever you cannot transmit the file yourself: no shell, a sandbox that refuses mcp.sportstracklive.com (403), no public link, or a file too large for `file_base64`. Give the user the link as a clickable URL, ask them to drop the file there and to tell you when it is done, THEN call the file tool with the `upload_id`. The link and the file both expire after 15 minutes; the file is deleted afterwards and never listed anywhere.
name: create_upload_link
